findings.note: She voted no on Senate second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) requires county boards to process a voter registration only if the applicant states citizenship, sets weekly removal of deceased voters, and sets a process to remove possible non-citizens flagged from a federal database.
